data.title: ABUNDIA GLOBAL IMPACT GROUP, INC. Q2 2026: Revenue $1.956M, EPS $(0.08) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to $1.956M versus $483.6K a year earlier, while the company widened its net loss and reported a larger loss per share for the quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $1.956M for Q2 2026, up from $483.6K in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 304%.
  • Net income: Net loss attributable to parent was $3.455M for Q2 2026 versus net loss $1.941M in the year-ago quarter (worsened YoY).
  • Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted loss per share was $(0.08) for Q2 2026 vs $(0.06) in the year-ago quarter (more negative YoY).

Business Highlights

  • Completed a reverse acquisition of AGIG in July 2025, transitioning from legacy oil & gas operations to low-carbon energy solutions.
  • Acquired RPD on April 1, 2026; RPD is now approximately 87% owned and added engineering, pilot plant and commercialization capabilities.
  • RPD drove revenue momentum as facility relocation completed and operations returned to normal capacity, producing a material year-over-year revenue increase.
  • Renewables segment remains pre-revenue and is advancing technology and construction of a plastics recycling facility to enable future product sales.
  • Operating and G&A expenses increased due to public company compliance, relocation costs, technology investments and commercialization activities tied to scale-up.

Original SEC Filing: ABUNDIA GLOBAL IMPACT GROUP, INC. [ AGIG ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026
